about: CaptureStability on scripted frame sequences (Lazy Scan's CaptureStabilityTests, same in Swift and C#). Frames are 1000 x 750, one every 33 ms, numbered from 0 across the segments. A held frame i of its segment (counted from 0) shifts the page by (dx + (i even ? 1 : -1), dy + i % 3 - 1); a drift frame i shifts it by (i * step, 0); a slide frame i by (step * (i % wrap), 0); a gap frame has no page and confidence 0. fired lists the frames the shutter fired on, state the state after the last frame.

scenarios.name: fires once when the page holds still
never fires while the page moves
never fires when the detection is unsure
a very unsure detection is no page
a dip above the stay level keeps steadying
a drop below the stay level starts over
time missing is not time held
the same page is not taken twice
the next page after the page leaves
the next page after the page moves
